newsitem.title: USA: Bell Atlantic has no plans for shr buyback.
newsitem.headline: Bell Atlantic has no plans for shr buyback.

text.p: Bell Atlantic Corp said Friday it "has no current plans" to start a share repurchase program.
The company said it may buy back up to $1 billion of its common stock under a previous authorization.
It added it may not buy back more than 35 million shares in the two years following the closing of its merger with NYNEX Corp under pooling of interests accounting rules.
"We said this to make sure people understood our intention was to describe the pooling of interest rules, not to announce a 35 million share buy-back program," a Bell Atlantic spokesman said.
The company earlier Friday said it can still buy back about 10 million shares based on their current price level under its current $1 billion buy-back program, which expires December 31.
The pooling of interest rules limit Bell Atlantic's repurchases to 35 million shares (or about $2.6 billion) over the next two years.
The company's stock traded at 75-3/8 Friday morning, down 9/16.
